alkylation reagent: alkylated with 11 mM iodoacetamide in the dark at room temperature for 15 min.
alkylation concentration: alkylated with 11 mM iodoacetamide in the dark at room temperature for 15 min.
cleavage agent: Trypsin digestion was performed at a 1:50 enzyme-to-protein ratio overnight.
enrichment method: Peptides were solubilized in IP buffer and incubated with succinyl-lysine-specific resin (PTM-402, PTM Bio) overnight at 4 °C on a rotator.
labeling: Label-free quantification was employed, maintaining identification and peptide-spectrum match FDRs at 1%.
precursor tolerance: Parent ion and fragment ion mass tolerances were set at 20 ppm.
fragment tolerance: Parent ion and fragment ion mass tolerances were set at 20 ppm.
ptm: fixed carbamidomethyl (C); variable acetylation of protein N-termini; variable methionine oxidation; variable lysine succinylation
Fixed modification was carbamidomethyl (C), and variable modifications included acetylation of protein N-termini, methionine oxidation, and lysine succinylation.
reduction reagent: The digested samples were then reduced with 5 mM dithiothreitol at 56 °C for 30 min
reduction concentration: The digested samples were then reduced with 5 mM dithiothreitol at 56 °C for 30 min
